paper_metadata.title: Effect of Carbide Additions on the Mechanical Properties and Microstructure of Nb-based Multiphase Alloy

evidence.quote: Fig.2 Microstructures of Nb-Ti-C alloys: (a, c) as cast Nb-21Ti-4C alloy; (b) heat treated Nb-21Ti-4C alloy; (e, f) as cast and heat treated Nb-35Ti-4C alloy; (g, h) as cast and heat treated Nb-25Ti-8C alloy

The mechanical properties and deformation behaviors of Nbss, (Nb, Ti)C, Nb 3Al and the interface for as cast and heat treated Nb-21Ti-4C- xAl ( x=0, 5, 10, 15 at%), Nb-35Ti-4C and Nb-25Ti-8C alloys were investigated using nanoindentation and atomic force microscopy (AFM).
